sentences.text:
Nilabja Gupta And Others vs The State Of West Bengal And
Another on 5 June, 2023

Author: Tirthankar Ghosh
Bench: Tirthankar Ghosh
 M/L20 C.R.R. 1937 of 2022
05.06.2023
Bpg.
In Re: An application under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure;

Nilabja Gupta and others Versus The State of West Bengal and another Ms. Sayanti Santra, Mr.
Chitra Bhanu Gupta.

Mr. Imran Ali, Ms. Debjani Sahu.
...for the State.

The present revisional application has been preferred challenging the investigational proceedings of Khardah Police Station Case No.256 of 2022 dated 07.04.2022 under Sections 498A/323/352/406/120B/34 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 3/4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.

entities.text: Khardah Police Station Case No.256 of 2022
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: The main thrust of contention of the present petitioners is that the present case was initiated immediately after the complaints were made to the administrative authorities as well as under Section 9 of the Hindu Marriage Act was filed for restitution of conjugal rights.
Learned advocate submits that the present case was instituted with the ulterior motive to pin down the husband and in- laws for harassing them.
I have considered the contentions advance by the petitioners.
Petitioners are directed to serve a copy of the revisional application upon Ms. Debjani Sahu, learned advocate, who ordinarily appears on behalf of the State.
Her appearance may be regularised by the concerned authorities.

Since the investigation of the case as is revealed from the records was continuing at the stage when the petitioners approached this Court, I am of the opinion considering the contentions advanced by Nilabja Gupta And Others vs The State Of West Bengal And Another on 5 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/156521956/
1 the petitioners in respect of the allegations made in the FIR the same at this stage do not call for interference by this Court.

entities.text: Nilabja Gupta And Others vs The State Of West Bengal And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Petitioners would be at liberty to canvass such points once the charge-sheet has been filed and after the documents under Section 207 of the Code of Criminal Procedure are served, at the stage of Section 239 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, if so advised.
With the aforesaid observations, CRR 1937 of 2022 is disposed of.
Pending application, if any, is consequently dismissed.
All parties shall act on the server copy of this order duly downloaded from the official website of this Court.
Urgent photostat certified copy of this order, if applied for, be supplied to the parties upon compliance of all requisite formalities.

(Tirthankar Ghosh, J.)
